hours.text: Office hours are 8am to 6pm daily, April through October. November through March: 9am to 5pm, closed Tuesdays.

rate_card.text: Transient slip: $2.50/ft/night. Monthly slip: $14/ft. Campsite (RV, full hookup): $65/night. Campsite (tent): $35/night.

fuel.text: Diesel and gas available at the fuel dock, 8am to 5pm daily in season. Card-only after hours.

cancellation_policy.text: Reservations cancelled 7+ days out: full refund minus $25 fee. Under 7 days: 50% refund. No-shows: no refund.

directions.text: From I-95, take exit 42 to Route 1 South. Marina entrance is 2 miles on the right, past the gas station.

insurance_requirement.text: All vessels over 20ft require proof of liability insurance ($300k minimum) on file before a slip is assigned.
